en.choose_the_mission_you_like_then_start_r: Choose the mission you like, then start reviewing features using pictures. If you see something, edit OpenStreetMap accordingly. Quite simple !

en.if_you_are_not_sure_of_what_to_do_click_: If you are not sure of what to do, click on "Next", someone else will review the feature
